//: Same division as .yamllint: Prettier decides layout, markdownlint decides whether the document is sound.
//MD013: Line length. Prettier runs with proseWrap: preserve, so it deliberately does not rewrap prose — leaving this on would flag lines nothing will ever fix, including the header's HTML and every long URL.
//MD033: Inline HTML, allowed by element rather than switched off. GitHub markdown cannot center a logo or lay out a badge row without it, and these are the tags the README actually uses — a <script> or an <iframe> appearing here should still be a finding.
//MD041: First line must be a heading. The README opens with a centered <div> holding the logo, which is the point of it.
